error_reason: The orchestrator instructed WebSurfer to scrape a single IMDb page for a complete list of Daniel Craig films with both ratings and runtimes, but no such authoritative page exists. This mis-specified plan prevented building a verified, filtered candidate set (<150 min) from IMDb before checking Netflix (US) availability, leading to ad hoc checks and the wrong final answer. Correctly specifying sources and a two-stage process (compile from IMDb -> filter by runtime and rating -> then verify Netflix US availability) would have enabled the right result.

hypotheses.rationale: The orchestrator directs WebSurfer to scrape 'the IMDb page about Daniel Craig movies' for a full list with ratings and durations. IMDb does not provide a single authoritative page listing all Daniel Craig films with both ratings and runtimes reliably; this instruction lacks a precise source and a plan to compile and filter candidates before checking Netflix availability. This early mis-specification prevented building a vetted candidate set (with IMDb ratings and <150 min filter) and led to later piecemeal availability checks and the unverified conclusion. Had the orchestrator first compiled a complete, verified list of eligible titles from IMDb with runtimes and ratings, the highest-rated candidate could have been correctly identified before verifying Netflix (US) availability.
hypotheses.check: Verify whether any subsequent step produced a complete, structured list of Daniel Craig films with IMDb ratings and runtimes sourced from IMDb, and whether a filter for <150 minutes was applied before checking Netflix availability. Compare steps 6, 41, 45, 76, and 88 to confirm the absence of a comprehensive candidate list and filtering.

evidence.discrepancy: Step 6 assumes a single IMDb page can be scraped to produce a complete, structured list with ratings and runtimes, and implies this dataset will be available for subsequent filtering. The trace shows no such comprehensive IMDb-derived list was produced; instead, later steps proceed with ad hoc Netflix availability checks without first establishing a vetted, filtered candidate set from IMDb.
